item.text:
The failure path is clear from the code: [`Forwarder.newStreamer`](/app/lib/kube/proxy/forwarder.go:569) opens `log/upload/streaming/default`, and [`filesessions.NewHandler`](/app/lib/events/filesessions/fileuploader.go:48) requires that directory to exist. [`initUploaderService`](/app/lib/service/service.go:1842) creates it, but the Kubernetes startup path in [`initKubernetesService`](/app/lib/service/kubernetes.go:70) does not call that initializer.

The other requested changes center on [`forwarder.go`](/app/lib/kube/proxy/forwarder.go:63): it caches whole `clusterSession` objects, uses request contexts for audit emission, and returns from exec errors before final audit events. [`server.go`](/app/lib/kube/proxy/server.go:123) supplies the heartbeat announcer. Existing [`forwarder_test.go`](/app/lib/kube/proxy/forwarder_test.go:88) asserts whole-session caching, so those tests would need to change with the implementation.

This is a source-based diagnosis; I did not run a runtime reproduction. My fault-localization role prohibited edits to project source and tests, so the issue remains unresolved. Findings are recorded in [checkpoint.md](/app/.codex-role-output/checkpoint.md).
